new_findings.title: 90-day overplayed rest is bypassed by cooling fallback in normal deck planning
new_findings.preconditions: Unblocked imported song:8 counted plays400daysago,4 early skips last40daysago, playedBeforeSkips8. Station pool40 with39 noncooling alternatives; normal initial station round covers previous365days.
reproduction: onboarded({tracks:40}); choose actual first imported library song and first actual station.
Call actual public hub.newNativeQueue(station.id), inspect saved deck via read-only SQL.
new_findings.expected: Song is excluded until90days after last early skip, as the changed UI and feature contract promise. Ordinary noncooling alternatives remain available.
new_findings.actual: Song appears in40-item saved native deck on day40. Independent pure planner reproduces with one normal alternative too.
new_findings.cause: New90-day cooling shares the existing24-hour cooling lane. Default allowCooling includes that lane to fill a deck; 90-day condition does not establish a separate enforced rest.
new_findings.repair_direction: Separate new overplayed rest eligibility from legacy24-hour soft fallback; preserve existing small-station24-hour behavior, stable existing queues and observations. Do not blanket-modify transport or all cooling rules.

Station round advance/extension and allowCooling variants
Existing24h small-pool behavior, bans, likes, consume and current session invariants

new_findings.title: First-win aggregate deduplication disagrees with last-win profile classification for overlapping exports
new_findings.preconditions: Two legitimate overlapping Spotify export files: shorter file starts with a skip; full file contains same timestamp/song/3second-forward skip after a180second preceding song.
reproduction: Use prior timestamp2026-09-24T06:00:00Z, skip+3seconds, reason_start trackdone and reason_end fwdbtn.
Fold files [skip], then [prior,skip] through aggregateHistory and addListens respectively.
Upload toRows(agg) with actual hub.importHistory and finishListens with actual two-part hub.importListens. Read listeningProfile UTC.
new_findings.expected: Same deduplicated occurrence produces one consistent opener/ordinary-skip verdict in memory/import effects and Hörprofil.
new_findings.actual: 78fc aggregate skipped0/openers1/no skipped-song memory row; profile early1/openers0. Exact same fixture passes coherence assertion at156ba.
new_findings.cause: New aggregate seen key prevents later full-context occurrence from replacing first boundary-opener decision; addListens Map.set replaces classification with later full-context decision.
new_findings.repair_direction: Use consistent occurrence conflict/deduplication handling for aggregate and listen rows; preserve first-entry unknown handling but do not make mix and profile contradict each other on a repeated occurrence.
required_checks: Short/full overlapping files in both upload orders
Boundary opener versus mid-listening ordinary skip
Five-before-first-skip overplayed classification coherence under overlapping file input
